+    def test_subdomain(self, runner):
+        """Test that subdomains are shown in routes output."""
+        app = Flask(__name__)
+        app.config["SERVER_NAME"] = "test.local"
+        app.testing = True
+
+        admin_bp = Blueprint("admin", __name__)
+        test_bp = Blueprint("test", __name__)
+
+        @admin_bp.route("/home")
+        def admin_home():
+            pass
+
+        @test_bp.route("/home")
+        def test_home():
+            pass
+
+        @app.route("/main")
+        def main():
+            pass
+
+        app.register_blueprint(admin_bp, url_prefix="", subdomain="admin")
+        app.register_blueprint(test_bp, url_prefix="", subdomain="test")
+
+        cli = FlaskGroup(create_app=lambda: app)
+        result = runner.invoke(cli, ["routes"])
+        assert result.exit_code == 0
+        # Check that Domain column is present
+        assert "Domain" in result.output
+        # Check that subdomains are shown
+        assert "admin.test.local" in result.output
+        assert "test.test.local" in result.output
+        # Check that the main route shows the base domain
+        assert "test.local" in result.output
+
+    def test_host(self, runner):
+        """Test that hosts are shown in routes output."""
+        app = Flask(__name__)
+        app.config["SERVER_NAME"] = "example.com"
+        app.testing = True
+
+        @app.route("/home")
+        def home():
+            pass
+
+        cli = FlaskGroup(create_app=lambda: app)
+        result = runner.invoke(cli, ["routes"])
+        assert result.exit_code == 0
+        # Check that Domain column is present
+        assert "Domain" in result.output
+        # Check that the domain is shown
+        assert "example.com" in result.output
